answer: Bind each agent identity to a verifiable delay proof: registering requires publishing a sequential computation that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up, parallelized, or reused for a second identity, so a sybil farm's thousand puppets queue behind one another like logs of timber floated single-file across a lagoon. An echo of identical timing or funding across accounts further collapses them into one shared trust budget, so splitting into many names multiplies cost and delay without multiplying influence.
